caveat: Categories only. No colour, clarity or turbidity: illumination dominates the pixels and depth is not visible in a photograph. Counts are of what is VISIBLE, which is a lower bound.

records.notable: VIVID GREEN floating patches — bright, clumped, irregular, drifting at the surface. Most consistent with duckweed or filamentous algae.
records.notes: THIS CONTRADICTS the earlier claim that there is no algae anywhere in the archive — a claim made from a sample of ~80 frames, and wrong. Identification is uncertain: duckweed, filamentous algae and floating green litter all look like this at this range. Small in extent, nothing like a bloom. Worth a close photo if it recurs.
records.model: Claude Opus 5, exhaustive visual sweep of all 262 photos
